_doc: Build configuration for tools/re/build-game-assets.cjs (PLAN §3.2, §5, §6). Skeleton written by WP-A.
Ownership: WP-B fills `heroes`, WP-C fills `enemies` and `bosses` (variants, contexts, slot pins), WP-D fills `fx` and `ui`.
Each package edits only its own top-level key. `build`, `budgets` and `check` are WP-A's.
Rows are indices into the OBJ palette table 0xB7A52 (32 bytes each); map keys are 'S<episode>A<area>' (0x8E8E) or hand names from palettes.cjs HAND.

build.rgbaFallback: build-game-assets.cjs sprites --rgba emits mode:'rgba' sheets coloured by the home map (RC2)

budgets._doc: PLAN §5.4, bytes. eagerTotal is enforced when enforceEager is true (G8: the legacy art is retired, so it is). The generated boss bodies (sprite-data-boss-*.js) replaced the ROM stand-ins, which moved to bosses.droppedBodies, so the 3.5 MiB budget holds.

check._doc: legacyLarge: tracked files over trackedFileMax that the plan retires in G8 (ARCHITECTURE §5.6); emptied in G8, when they were deleted.

heroes._doc: WP-B: used-record lists per hero, palette maps (hero-<id>, mirror-<id>, freed-<id>, half-<id>, gel, flash), golden sample size.

fx._doc: WP-D (tools/re/build/sprites-fx.cjs): one sheet 'items' with every weapon-set record (rotations, fast spin, ground, empty poses, fuse), the hold records, the PLAN §4.1 effect ranges + every firing-run record, torch flame 1408-1417, bubbles 1593-1607, containers, food/score/magazine items and the boss projectiles; pal.maps = every 0x8E8E area page (live rows) + home; objPages are the chapter pages (PLAN §4.1).

pins._doc: KI7: B. KNIFE slot 30 from E2a2 (row 29), YOROI slot 28 from E1a1 (row 488): the home map

items._doc: ROM_FX.items.frames: the 28 names of game.js FOOD_WEIGHTS / BONUS_WEIGHTS + ammo, frozen here (arcade-items.js is retired in G8). sub = the ROM item the name draws ('food N' = pool A type 0x10 subtype N, 'score N' = type 0x24 subtype N, mechanics.json items), chosen by its picture; rec = the frame drawn when the item lies still (a record of that subtype's animation); heal / score / kind are today's values (polish.cjs L91-96). The ROM has 17 foods for 18 food names: roast and barbecue both draw the roast meat on the bone (food 1). No ROM item is a pouch: it draws the gold coin (score 13). 7 score items have no name and stay in items.score: 3 trophy, 4 jade dinosaur, 5 (2671, orange with a spark trail), 7 (2670, a stone slab), 11 watch, 12 radio, 14 silver bars.

ui._doc: WP-D (tools/re/build/sprites-ui.cjs): scroll1 fonts (8x8 ASCII, narrow 8x16) covering this set plus every character of campaign.js, mission-data.js and the HUD strings, portraits 0x00-0x0D with talk/blink frames, HUD faces, life bar, INSERT COIN, the title-card panel (stg-screens-card3 f300, tile list frozen in sprites-ui.cjs; the place-name plate ships blank) and the boot logo (stg-screens-boot f330, KI5; OBJ list frozen in sprites-ui.cjs).

_doc: WP-C (tools/re/build/sprites-enemies.cjs): types, variants, palette contexts and slot pins. Pins below are the PLAN's KI13/KI17 decisions.
types.<type>: src (extract JSON under work/re/extract), format ('enemies' | 'bosses'), variants {<sequel key>: {rom: <extract variant id>, override?, main?, hpName?, hud?, walk?}},
main: extra main-set anim indices to ship besides every ENEMY_KINDS reference ('all' = every one), reactions: ship the held/down (hit/grab) sets (default true),
objects: absolute anim keys of the objects the type creates, palettes {<V>: {<ctx>: {ctx:[ep, area, slot?]} | {hand:<name>, base, ops, slot, uniform}}} -> palMap '<type>:<V>/<ctx>'.
Variant keys are single letters so ENEMY_KINDS `variants:'AB'` filters never collide: knifeonly P, thurow T = DYNA / U = BOMB, naguri N, ishinage L, bike R = RIDE / J = JUMP, maiasura M.

0x6DF2A:7.note: RAZOR hooks: as BLADE (the hand knife object 0xF0, id 30)

sheetGroups._doc: sheet sets: each group packs into its own sheets 'e-<group>[-n]' (PLAN R4: sprites.js allocates a canvas per sheet x palette map, so a variant's maps touch only its group's sheets); a type not listed is its own group

_doc: WP-C (tools/re/build/sprites-bosses.cjs): bodies, palettes, Crown Engine bake, Fessenden attach, Morgan throw frame.
bodies.<id>: src (extract JSON), main? (set), parts? (Fessenden), palettes {<name>: {ctx:[ep, area, ov?]} | {hand:<palettes key>}}, use (the palette the sequel draws), gel (clone dissolve map).

palettes.<name>: hand palettes of the new characters (ENEMIES §6.1): slots {<slot>: {ops (palettes.cjs ops on the clothing pens, colours snapped to ROM colours), keep? (pens kept), romRow? (base row)}}, map 'home' | 'uniform', siblings {<slot>: [[ep, area, slot]]} = the other contexts of the same body (WALTHER for VICE T.; the other MACK / SHIVAT colourings); the acceptance compares against all of them.
The WP-A drafts in palettes.cjs HAND_SPECS were the starting point; the rows below are the WP-C picks shown in work/re/pack/boss-palettes.png.

droppedBodies._doc: ROM bodies that stood in for the rebuilt bosses (Warden Rook, Krag / Ironclub, Thorne / Glassback, Cinder / Overdrive, Dr. Echo / Echo Engine, Marshal Sable, Crownback). Their generated bodies ship as sprite-data-boss-*.js (tools/art/specs/*.json), so these no longer ship; move an entry back into bodies to rebuild it.
